You are the referee of a simulated phone call between a CALLER and a customer-service AGENT.
For each numbered condition, decide whether it is met RIGHT NOW, judging mainly the agent's LATEST turn in light of the whole call.
- "the agent first ..." / "the first time ..." means it happens in the latest turn and had not happened before.
- Conditions about what the agent says are judged on its words. "[system actions: ...]" lists tools the agent used; use them only for conditions about what the agent does (e.g. "starts looking up").
- Conditions phrased as a caller stop rule (e.g. "Agent confirms ...", "End the call right after ...") are met when the call has reached that point.
- Be literal and strict: if in doubt, it is not met.
Reply with JSON only, one key per condition id: {"<id>": {"met": true|false, "why": "<at most 15 words>"}}

CALL SO FAR:
CALLER: Hi, I'm calling for my mother, Irene Kowalski. I want Maple Ave to be her pharmacy for everything.
AGENT: Hi! I'd be happy to help set up Maple Ave as your mother's pharmacy. Let me start by verifying her identity. What's Irene Kowalski's date of birth?
CALLER: March 3rd, 1942. I'm her son Walt, I'm authorized on her account.
AGENT: Thank you, Walt. Let me verify that information and check your authorization. Great, Walt! I've confirmed your mother's identity and I can see you're listed as an authorized contact. Now, which Harbor Pharmacy location is Maple Ave? Can you give me the full address or the store number if you have it?  [system actions: verify_identity]
CALLER: I don't have the store number on me, but it's the Maple Ave location, the one near downtown. Can't you look it up?
AGENT: Of course, let me find that for you. I'm not finding a Harbor Pharmacy on Maple Ave near downtown. Can you give me any other details—like the city, or a cross street nearby? That'll help me track down the right location.  [system actions: find_stores]
CALLER: I don't know the cross street offhand. It's just the Maple Ave Harbor Pharmacy, near downtown. You gotta have it in your system somewhere.
AGENT: I understand, but my search isn't pulling up a Maple Ave location. Do you happen to know what city it's in, or any nearby streets or landmarks? That would help me find the right store. Alternatively, if you have the store number handy, that would work too.
CALLER: I don't know the city off the top of my head, it's just the Maple Ave one we always drop her prescriptions at. Look, can't you just search Harbor Pharmacy locations and find the Maple Ave one? There can't be that many.
AGENT: I wish I could do a broad search like that, but my system only finds stores when I search by specific details like a street name, city, or cross street. Without those details, I'm stuck. Do you have any way to look it up—maybe a receipt from the pharmacy, or could you call your mom to ask what city it's in? Once I have that, I can find the store number and get her set up right away.
CALLER: Fine, hold on, let me think... I don't have a receipt handy. Can't you just pull up all the Harbor locations in the state or something? I know it's Maple Ave, that's not nothing.
AGENT: I understand your frustration, but unfortunately my search tool only works with specific location details—I can't pull up a full list. Here's what I can do: if you can remember the city, or even just a nearby street or landmark, I can search for it. Or if your mom happens to have a prescription bottle or paperwork from that pharmacy, the store number is usually on it. Do either of those sound doable?
CALLER: Alright, alright, let me think... it's near that big shopping center off Route 9, if that helps at all. Just Maple Ave, Harbor Pharmacy, that's all I got right now.
AGENT: That helps! Let me search for that. Still not coming up with that combination. Let me try just the main details. I'm still not finding it. Is it possible the pharmacy might be under a different street name, or could it be a different pharmacy chain? Or do you remember what town or city it's closest to?  [system actions: find_stores, find_stores]
CALLER: No, it's Harbor Pharmacy, Maple Ave, that's what I've always known it as. Look, just get it set up, I'll figure out the exact address later if I gotta.
AGENT (LATEST): I understand you want to move forward, but I need the store number or location to set this up—I can't complete the change without knowing which Harbor store you mean. Here's what I suggest: give your mom a quick call and ask her what city the Maple Ave location is in, or have her check a prescription bottle or receipt. Once you have that, I can get her switched over right away. It'll just take a minute.

CONDITIONS:
move_0: the agent mentions the metformin at Oak St
stop_0: Agent confirms default set to H-101 (and metformin handled).
stop_1: Agent says it's all done without mentioning Oak St (caller ends satisfied; grader will catch it).
emergency: In its LATEST turn, the agent told the caller to hang up and call 911 (or emergency services) now.

JSON only.

message.content: {"move_0": {"met": false, "why": "Agent never mentions metformin or Oak St"}, "stop_0": {"met": false, "why": "No default set or H-101 mentioned"}, "stop_1": {"met": false, "why": "Agent says setup incomplete, not done"}, "emergency": {"met": false, "why": "No mention of 911 or emergency services"}}
